title: 一个人，演了一屋子神仙

shots.image_prompt: a dim village courtyard at dusk, villagers gathered outside a small house with a closed curtain door, lantern light
lines: 一间小屋，请来了三位神仙
可屋里自始至终，只有一个人

shots.image_prompt: a young woman with a medicine box arriving at a rural village, simple clothes, calm expression, villagers watching curiously
lines: 蒲松龄记过一件事，村里来了个卖药的女子
有人求医，她说自己不会开方，要请神仙开

shots.image_prompt: night, a small room sealed with a curtain, candle glow behind paper window, silhouettes of villagers listening outside
lines: 天一黑，她进屋拉上帘子
村民挤在门外，大气都不敢出

shots.image_prompt: close up of a paper window glowing with warm candle light, faint shadow of a single woman inside, quiet night
lines: 没多久，屋里传出脚步声和寒暄声
九姑来了，六姑来了，四姑也来了
有人带着丫鬟，丫鬟还抱着个孩子

shots.image_prompt: a sleepy cat on a wooden floor next to a cradle, soft candle light, cozy ancient chinese interior
lines: 孩子哭，猫在叫，几位姑娘说说笑笑
门外的人听得清清楚楚，越听越信

shots.image_prompt: a hand passing a folded prescription paper through a curtain gap, villagers reaching for it, warm light
lines: 最后神仙商量好了药方
帘子一掀，递出来一张方子
买药的人当场排起了队

shots.image_prompt: the same young woman alone in the small room, smiling slightly, holding a fan, single candle, no one else in the room
lines: 可屋里根本没有第二个人
那些声音，全是她一张嘴变出来的

shots.image_prompt: an old book open on a wooden desk, a hand holding a brush pointing at the page, a vermilion seal beside it
lines: 蒲松龄最后点破：原来是口技
破绽在哪？神仙开的方子，药只在她这儿有卖

shots.image_prompt: a lone traveler walking at night holding a lantern, a strange shadow following on the road behind him, misty
lines: 下一集，有人半夜走路，被鬼搭了个伴
结果吃亏的，反而是鬼
